items.control: transactional IndexedDB, Vault restore, migration receipts, fault injection
inert parsing, sanitizer fixtures, worker/resource bounds, no authority escalation

items.risk: credential or AI context crosses owner boundary
items.control: credential/key broker, context broker, capability handles, command admission

items.risk: static host silently lacks required runtime behavior
items.control: frozen support matrix, truthful PLATFORM_LIMITED states, offline smoke

items.risk: supply-chain or license defect reaches release
items.control: lockfile, SBOM, exact-source register, license/currentness/security gates

rule: UNKNOWN, stale, skipped, or unverified controls are not PASS and remain release-visible.
